0022600172.text: The Miami Heat (2-4, 10th in the East, 4th in the Southeast and 1 game back) are on a two-game winning streak and have a 1-3 home record and a 1-1 road record, while the Los Angeles Lakers (5-2, 1st in the Pacific and 4th in the West) are on a one-game winning streak. Tim Hardaway Jr. is day-to-day for Miami with a personal reason and is a game-time decision, and Los Angeles will be without Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and Ziaire Williams (foot), both listed as out. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Miami lost both games to the Lakers in 2025-26, most recently a 134-126 defeat in Miami on March 19, 2026.
